plugin_interpreter_description: When teammates speak another language, she listens to the game or voice app in the background and shows each sentence translated into your language as danmaku or a bubble
plugin_interpreter_off_note: Once it's on, set which program to listen to, the language and how to show it here; click Start and she listens to your teammates in the background and translates each sentence for you.
plugin_interpreter_app_desc: The program's process name, e.g. Discord.exe or KOOK.exe; leave it empty for the current game.
plugin_interpreter_note: Clicking Start is the same as saying this to her in the chat: she hands the listening and translating to the background, and each foreign sentence she hears is translated with her model (billed by the model you use). Clicking Stop is telling her to stop interpreting.
plugin_interpreter_recognizer_local_note: Uses Kotone's speech recognition: the one you chose if it understands foreign languages, otherwise SenseVoice on this PC (Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, Cantonese). Your teammates' voices stay on this PC. Stopping local speech recognition stops interpreting too.
plugin_interpreter_recognizer_online_not: Uses the online recognition you chose: every sentence your teammates say is sent to it and billed per sentence (shown in usage).
